units.translation: In the same meaning of 'to happen' it is frequently constructed with an infinitive by other authors, once in Aeschylus,
Such are the rewards that come to pass.
For the sacrifices are not becoming favorable.
Nor are the signs becoming wound-inflicting.
The tongue becomes a true accuser.
These things are not easy to conceal.
When judgment is absent, great ruin comes to pass.
How is the expense not becoming bitter?
Toward which the watery snow becomes a drinking-cup.
Many falls of men happen before.
But it has happened more to the children.
I will become woman-minded.
I will not become ripe to your enemies.
What will happen?
How will he become an ally to you?
But this man will not be unburied.
And how blood of kin will not come to pass.
Then I became base.
But when he became sound of mind.
How may I become a deserter of the fleet?
So that I may not become a slave-woman.
Do not become like him in anger.
And do not become soft.
And do not become a drag in speech.
I fear that my great toil of wealth may become for men a plunder of the one who got there first.
So that he may become the all-powerful murderer of both of these.
Lest – strife may come to pass.
So that they may become successors of the greatest toils for mortals (thus Dawes for γένωνθ').
May I never become subject to another's power.
May I become black smoke.
Nor would you become less a friend to the house.
Which may it not happen.
Of which Zeus the Averter may become the namesake.
Perhaps folly may become a prophet to someone (ἡ ἀνοία corrected in M).
This boastful sign may become a namesake.
May Zeus become savior.
May it happen thus.
He would become a wondrous man.
For all Hellas would become subject to the king.
What fortune could become more hateful than this?
May the deliverance become fortunate.
May he become a bearer of good news until dawn.
The ruin of the dead would become awake.
May it happen in the best way.
How could the healing bond of an oath come to pass?
But may it not happen somehow.
And from the father's side an avenger would become a helper.
But if there should be enough of these toils.
From a small seed a great trunk would become.
May it happen thus.
May it happen in the best way.
It would become a burden.
The murder of a kinsman would not become a murderer.
But it would never become utterly destroyed.
He would become a teacher of the matter correctly.
A father would become without a mother.
So that he may become trustworthy.
How could one who marries an unwilling woman from an unwilling father become pure?
Other things would happen.
A word would become a charming word of a story.
May it turn out well.
Thus it would not become a fine departure of the army.
What would happen.
So that you may become trustworthy in this need.
Become the city's savior.
And become a healer of this anxiety.
Become a willing ally to me.
Be within.
Become a spectator of these events.
And be with me against the enemies.
Become a wholly just and pious protector.
Become one who remembers much, a defender of Io.
Become a clear scribe.
Let the path become strewn with purple.
Let him become a deliverer.
Obey and let it happen.
Become a defense.
Become counselors of this word to me.
